event.distribution_pattern: distributed in Oregon and sold to consumers through mail orders. The firm did not keep records regarding who the product was sold to.

products.product_description: Pacific Black Cod, NW Wild Products, 6.5 oz. metal cans. No UPC
products.code_info: any codes starting with OC and it can be found on top or bottom of a can. Last date of distribution was September 2015.
products.reason_for_recall:
All canned black cod, salmon, sardines, steelhead, sturgeon, tuna, and Razor clams with any codes starting with
OC
because it has the potential to be contaminated with Clostridium botulinum.
